question: Should every Android ClawSegmentedControl wrap automatically above four options, or should only Skill Workshop opt into the multi-row layout?
rationale: The implementation is correct for the demonstrated screen, but choosing global shared-component behavior versus a caller-specific capability is a design-system policy decision that source and tests cannot settle.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the shared one-row default and let Skill Workshop request balanced wrapping, minimizing behavior changes for other callers.

options.title: Adopt global wrapping
options.body: Declare automatic wrapping above four options as the shared Android component contract and retain the patch’s current API.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the shared one-row default and let Skill Workshop request balanced wrapping, minimizing behavior changes for other callers.
